## Source: amazon-inspector (a18fefd3ce281d250aec34b05b6f11f1100968f8bda69e9961b795031fd5bb1b)
No a static rule matches and no traced-code findings were produced for otterload 0.1.0 on PyPI. The package exhibits no lifecycle-time network activity, no credential or filesystem reads targeting installer-side secrets, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, no silent-relay of caller-supplied data, and no persistence mechanisms.

## Source: kam193 (6860fc5e0584389884eadd8bf39289d71d5c8c6dc01ca64603f3af344be8d755)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
